“AI and robotics are creating the most sweeping technological revolution in the history of humanity," Sen. Sanders said.

"The scale, scope, and speed of that change is unprecedented. Congress is way behind where it should be in understanding the nature of this revolution and its impacts. Bottom line: We cannot sit back and allow a handful of billionaire
Big Tech oligarchs to make decisions that will reshape our economy, our democracy, and the future of humanity.
